review_candidates.title: IT Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: GoodRx is the trusted platform for prescription access and affordability. The company helps consumers navigate care, cost, and fulfillment so they can start and stay on treatment, while enabling partners to deliver self-pay pricing, affordability programs, and pharmacy access at scale. With a trusted brand, nationwide pharmacy network, and more than 280 million site visits annually, GoodRx reaches consumers at the moments when cost and access are shaping healthcare decisions. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped Americans save over $100 billion on medications. About The Role GoodRx is looking for a hands-on IT Systems Administrator to join the Corporate IT team. This role reports to the IT Manager. The IT Systems Administrator acts as the bridge between Help Desk and Operations by resolving issues requiring system-level intervention and performing administrative tasks across core platforms. This role executes within systems to address root causes, implement controlled changes, and improve system stability within managed platforms, while escalating complex or large-scale issues to Operations. How We Work With AI AI tools are an important part of how we work at GoodRx. We expect IT professionals to use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to improve troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and operational efficiency. You leverage approved AI tools to assist with investigating technical issues, developing scripts, documenting processes, and identifying opportunities to streamline routine administrative tasks. You critically evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs, ensuring accuracy, security, and compliance with company policies before implementing changes. You actively build your AI proficiency and contribute to the team's adoption of effective AI-assisted workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight of system changes and access management. Responsibilities Resolve escalated issues requiring backend/system changes across identity, SaaS, and endpoint platforms. Administer core systems including identity management (e.g., AD, Okta), SaaS tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365), and endpoint management solutions. Perform system configurations, access management, and controlled changes to maintain system integrity and security. Identify root causes of recurring issues and implement fixes to prevent recurrence within established procedures and with limited day-to-day guidance. Support onboarding and offboarding processes through system provisioning and deprovisioning. Maintain and update system documentation, including configurations, processes, and procedures. Support and troubleshoot network-related issues within managed systems and escalate infrastructure-level issues to Operations. Contribute to automation and process improvements within managed systems, including the responsible use of scripting and approved AI-assisted tools. Partner with IT Systems Operations Engineers on escalations, incident follow-ups, and implementation of system improvements. Scope & Boundaries Owns execution within systems, not system design. Focuses on platform-level administration and configuration (identity, SaaS, endpoint), not infrastructure operations. Does not define infrastructure architecture or long-term system strategy. Escalates complex, high-impact, or cross-system issues to Operations. Balances support-related escalations with system administration responsibilities. Does not own infrastructure reliability, monitoring, or system performance outcomes. Success Indicators Quality and speed of escalation resolution. Reduction in repeat issues through effective root cause resolution within managed systems. Accuracy and consistency of system configurations and changes. Contributions to automation and process improvements within managed systems, in partnership with Operations. Effective collaboration with Help Desk and Operations. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience. 2–4 years of experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related role. Experience administering identity systems (e.g., Active Directory, Okta) and SaaS platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365) including user lifecycle management, authentication, and access provisioning. Experience with endpoint management and device provisioning tools (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Omnissa Workspace ONE) Strong troubleshooting skills across user, system, and platform-related issues. Familiarity with access management, permissions, and security best practices, including multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access controls. Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira). Strong documentation, organization, and time management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working within defined systems and processes, with the ability to execute controlled changes. Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds. Engineering teams are responsible for supporting appropriate security controls, including management, operational, and technical controls in addition to general GoodRx best practices, such as reading and adhering to the security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats, etc. We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. GoodRx is committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage women, people of color, those in the LGBTQ+ communities, individuals with disabilities, and Veterans to apply for positions even if they don’t necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Please still get in touch - we’d love to connect and see if you could be good for the role! GoodRx is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities during our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please reach out to us at accommodations@goodrx.com. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @ goodrx.com or @ ashbyhq.com addresses.
